# PM003: story-structure

> Generated: do not edit this page. Regenerate with `cargo dev gen rules`.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| family | PM |

A story lacks one of `as_a`, `i_want`, `so_that`, or one is shorter than three words.

A structured story is `persona` (as a), `capability` (I want) and
`outcome_text` (so that), each at least three words, so the goal names who
wants what and why.

## Remedy

Set the missing parts, for example `frob ticket new --type story --as-a ...
--i-want ... --so-that ...`.

## Examples

### PM003 story structure / A complete story is clean #1 (line 8) (clean)

```text
story a criteria=1
```

### PM003 story structure / A story without its value parts fires #2 (line 14) (fire)

```text
story a value=none
```

### PM003 story structure / A one-word persona fires #3 (line 20) (fire)

```text
story a as_a=maintainer
```

### PM003 story structure / A short so_that fires #4 (line 26) (fire)

```text
story a so=faster
```

### PM003 story structure / A quality objective is exempt #5 (line 32) (clean)

```text
story a value=none flavour=objective
```

### PM003 story structure / A done story is not examined #6 (line 38) (clean)

```text
story a value=none state=done
```
